source_refs.note: Example 25.3.1 Paracetamol (TM): a main subheading of 25.3 Synthesis of Pharmaceutical Products, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 139-139.

blocks.text: Paracetamol ki seedhi (direct) synthesis

blocks.alt: Phenol (benzene ring par HO), phir chaar chhote arrows 'A series of steps', aur aakhir mein paracetamol: benzene ring par HO aur saamne wali position par N(H)-C(=O)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis (kitab ke page 139 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Dekha ja sakta hai ke paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis mein kai steps lagte hain. Yeh steps kaun se hain, yeh retrosynthesis se is tarah maloom hota hai:
Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis
Step I Disconnection
Pehla step paracetamol ke amide group ka C–N bond torna hai, jis se synthons milte hain: HO–C₆H₄–NH⁻ (A) aur CH₃CO⁺ (B).

blocks.alt: Paracetamol ke amide C-N bond par wavy (lehredaar) slash, 'Disconnection' arrow, phir HO-C6H4-NH jis ke N par negative charge hai, synthon (A), aur acylium ion +C(=O)CH3, synthon (B).
blocks.caption: Paracetamol, Step I: disconnection (kitab ke page 139 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Step II Synthetic Equivalents (SE)
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride.

blocks.alt: Synthon (A) 4-aminophenol (SE) ke barabar; synthon (B) acyl chloride (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol, Step II: synthetic equivalents (kitab ke page 140 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Bond isi jagah toora gaya kyun ke in synthons ke synthetic equivalents nucleophilic addition-elimination reaction se aapas mein react karne ke liye jaane pehchane hain.
Step III Functional group interconversion
FGI is liye kiya gaya ke p-nitrophenol (4-nitrophenol) aasani se banta hai aur phir use reduce kar ke p-aminophenol (4-aminophenol) banaya ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: 4-Aminophenol, FGI likha khula (open) retrosynthetic arrow, aur 4-nitrophenol.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol, Step III: functional group interconversion (FGI) (kitab ke page 140 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Step III (FGI) mein aam reaction wala arrow (→) chhapa hai, jo ulta matlab deta hai ke 4-aminophenol se 4-nitrophenol banta hai. Retrosynthesis mein FGI ka open retrosynthetic arrow (⇒) hota hai; is liye hamare diagram mein yahi arrow hai.
Step IV Disconnection
Phir 4-nitrophenol ka C–N bond toora gaya. Is se 4-hydroxy aryl anion (HO–C₆H₄⁻) aur nitronium (NO₂⁺) cation synthons bane.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step IV mein “disconnection of 4-aminophenol” aur anion ka formula “C₆H₅⁻” chhapa hai. Asal mein jo molecule toota hai woh 4-nitrophenol hai (scheme mein yahi bana hai), aur 4-hydroxy aryl anion ka formula HO–C₆H₄⁻ hai.

blocks.alt: 4-Nitrophenol ke C-NO2 bond par wavy slash, 'Disconnection' arrow, phir negative charge wala HO-C6H4 synthon (A) aur NO2+ synthon (B).
blocks.caption: Paracetamol, Step IV: disconnection (kitab ke page 140 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Step V Synthetic Equivalents (SE)
In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: phenol aur nitric acid.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step V ke text mein “benzene and nitric acid” likha hai; scheme ke mutabiq 4-hydroxy aryl anion ka synthetic equivalent phenol hai, benzene nahi.

blocks.alt: Synthon (A) phenol (SE) ke barabar; synthon (B) nitric acid HO-NO2 (SE) ke barabar.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol, Step V: synthetic equivalents (kitab ke page 140 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Paanch steps tarteeb se: Step I mein amide ka C–N bond toota, Step II mein synthons ki jagah 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride aaye. Step III ka khula (open) arrow (⇒) kehta hai: “4-aminophenol 4-nitrophenol se ban sakta hai”. Step IV aur V mein 4-nitrophenol ko phenol aur nitric acid tak toora gaya.
Paracetamol ki synthesis

Ab paracetamol is scheme ke mutabiq banaya jata hai: phenol ki nitration (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) se 4-nitrophenol, phir Sn + HCl se reduction kar ke 4-aminophenol, aur aakhir mein CH₃COCl ke saath reaction se paracetamol.

blocks.alt: Phenol, 'phenol (SM)', arrow ke oopar HNO3 aur neeche H2SO4 se 4-nitrophenol; Sn + HCl se 4-aminophenol; neeche ki taraf arrow CH3COCl se paracetamol, 'Paracetamol (TM)'.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki synthesis (kitab ke page 140 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenol ki nitration se 4-nitrophenol ke saath 2-nitrophenol bhi banta hai, jise alag kar liya jata hai. Phir Sn + HCl NO₂ ko NH₂ mein reduce karta hai, aur aakhir mein CH₃COCl amino group ko amide (NHCOCH₃) bana deta hai.
